fullContentHtml:
IBPS Clerk CSA 16th Pre Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the Pre Admit Card for the post of Customer Service Associate (Clerk). This recruitment was released for 11,403 posts. Applications for the IBPS Clerk CSA 16th Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 01 August 2026, to 28 August 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 11 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their IBPS Clerk CSA 16th Pre Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 01 August 2026
  • Last Date for Registration : 28 August 2026 (Extend)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 August 2026
  • Correction Form : 04-05 September 2026
  • PET Admit Card : 29 September 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 11 October 2026
  • Pre Admit Card : 01 October 2026
  • Result : Notify Soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 175/-
  • PH : Rs. 175/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is IBPS Clerk CSA 16th Pre Admit Card 2026?

IBPS Clerk CSA 16th Pre Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
